title: Footer
description: Footer component for displaying site logo, grouped navigation links, social links and a legal bottom bar at the bottom of the page.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Small image placed on its own line at the very bottom of the footer, for a seal, certification or origin mark

alt.title: Alt Text
alt.description: Alt text to display for the badge. Leave empty when the badge is purely decorative

inverted.title: Inverted
inverted.description: Invert the color scheme of the footer

navGroups.title: Navigation Groups
navGroups.description: Groups of navigation links with headings, displayed as columns in the footer

heading.title: Column Heading
heading.description: Heading displayed above the navigation links in this column

headingUrl.title: Column Link
headingUrl.description: Turns the column heading into a link. A column that only sets a heading and a link, with no links below it, becomes a single flat entry - add one per menu entry to build a one-dimensional footer navigation.

copyright.title: Copyright
copyright.description: Copyright notice displayed in the footer bottom bar

legalLink.title: Legal Link
legalLink.description: Link to the legal/privacy page displayed in the footer bottom bar

socialLinks.title: Social Links
socialLinks.description: Social media links displayed in the footer, rendered with icons from the icon sprite

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Icon identifier from the icon sprite (e.g. facebook, twitter, linkedin, xing)

ariaLabel.title: Accessible Label
ariaLabel.description: Accessible label for the social link (announced by screen readers)
